notes: Conference sponsor/exhibitor pages to scrape for hardware-aligned prospects (ICP lane 2). Each entry: name, type, sponsor/exhibitor list URL, scrape strategy, lastScrapedAt. Add/edit as Brian discovers more relevant events. Defense-only and S/W-only conferences are intentionally excluded — those would belong in a separate S/W lead-research agent. 2026-05-29: expanded with major mechanical/electrical engineering + manufacturing shows per Brian's broadened ICP. Note many sponsor pages are JS-rendered or auth-walled (see degraded flags) and need a Chrome/Puppeteer scrape path, not plain WebFetch.

conferences.name: ASME IMECE

conferences.name: RoboBusiness

conferences.name: The Battery Show North America
conferences.notes: Battery + EV powertrain engineering. Energy/EV ICP lane.

conferences.name: IEEE ECCE
conferences.notes: IEEE Energy Conversion Congress & Expo — power electronics, EE-heavy. Electrical-engineering audience.

conferences.name: CES
conferences.notes: Huge — filter hard to hardware-product + dev-tool companies, not media/retail. Useful for consumer-hardware startups (e.g. Eight Sleep-type) that buy engineering-audience media.
